title: Shinonome Ena — You Never Fail〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's see... I've got plenty of pencils.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And my unused sketchbooks should be over here...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I never expected Kanade to ask me to teach her how to draw.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (“It might help me with composing”, she said...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She really never changes.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki and Mafuyu wanting to join in was an added surprise. But they all want to learn, so I'll need to do a good job.)
The next day
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, there are a few more of you here than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
We heard that you'd be doing a fun activity, so we decided to come over.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: These kinds of things are way better when you've got a big group, right? So I took the initiative!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honestly... Well, I did bring over extra colored pencils, so I guess it won't be too much of a problem...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Am I really going to be able to teach so many people, though?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're having us draw the lake and the tree today, yes?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right. I was originally gonna hold this outside... But it looks like it's a good thing I decided to do it in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! It's time for Ms. Enanan's art class to start!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow, Rin, Len, you guys are amazing!
The leaves and stuff are exactly the right color!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This is nothing...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ena has been teaching us how to draw from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, so Ms. Enanan's been doing a good job of teaching you guys?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I haven't taken them under my wing or anything. Rin and Len just seem to like watching me draw.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Drawing is so difficult.
I honestly don't know what to do next.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Lemme see... Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's all black...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I decided to add some shading, and look what happened. What should I do now?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know if she did this seriously or if she's pulling a practical joke on me...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow, Mafuyu, this is amazing...
The lake and tree look so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I just drew what I see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's why it's amazing. How is it that you're good at everything? Do you know how frustrating that is for me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, it isn't bad.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... The leaves look something like this... And this branch has three... No, four? So...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just don't feel like I'm doing it right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's not true!
The way you drew the waves here is really unique...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you've done a good job of drawing all the finer parts of each leaf!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, I'd rather you point out anything that looks funny to you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ah...sure.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Ena, how is your drawing coming along?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mine? I'm still not done. This is what I have for now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You really are an amazing artist...
The tree and lake both look so real...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Y-You think so? But it's still just a rough sketch, so I really don't think it deserves that much praise...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, we're drawing the exact same thing, but I can tell immediately that this is your art.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I really do love your art, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (How does she do it?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Her words always seem to hit straight to my heart.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Ena!
Rin said she wants you to show her how to draw waves better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I didn't.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? But you were just asking yourself how to do it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I'll be right over.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I promise to get around to all of you, so just bear with me here.
